fire: A right triangle can have sides of 6, 8, and 10.
A square has 4 sides, all of which are equal.
A triangle may have sides of lengths 5, 12, and 13.
A hexagon has 6 sides, all of which are lines.
Sides of lengths 8, 15, and 17 make a right triangle.

A house has 4 doors, all of which are locked.
A family may have children of ages 5, 12, and 13.
A hotel has 6 floors, all of which are full.
Boys of ages 8, 15, and 17 make a small team.
